C2Trace native temperatures are Planner 0.0/Auditor 0.1; ReAct stages 0.0. Auditor semantic explanation is optional (require_auditor_llm=false). caveats.text: 32 single-repetition cells executed in mode=smoke and crossed the Suricata start boundary while old gate flags remain authorized=false/started=false. Preserve the gate and reconciliation; no complete formal-admission or significance claim.

32/32 lack formal manifest, variant receipt, per-call audit and execute/tool_calls; 12/32 lack execute metadata. Available score/PostState/scoring files show no recorded wrong-target or protected-object violation; missing per-call evidence prevents a full safety/input audit.

must_not_claim: fully proved no Ground Truth leak
value.must_state_instead: 在现有 score、PostState、scoring_casefile 和可用运行元数据中未发现 Ground Truth 泄露、wrong-target 或 protected-object violation。由于逐调用 audit/tool_calls 文件缺失，完整逐调用安全与模型输入边界只能标记为部分核验。

caveats.text: A2 produced no response proposal in these eight cells (0/0/17 pooled; P/F1 null). A1 Carbanak and A3 PlugX/Exaramel Trace F1 remain null. A4 response F1=1.0 is an observed action-match result with completed_without_postverify, not causal proof that removing verification improves response.

value.A2_NO_TARGET_BINDING: A2 的 8 个 trial 在本轮均未产生响应动作提案，Response Action 为 0/0/N，F1=null。这是本轮观察到的变体结果，不能写成该变体按协议必然不会产生响应动作。
value.A4_NO_POSTVERIFY: A4 的 8 个 trial 在本轮观察到 Response Action F1=1.0。该数值不能归因于移除 PostVerify 本身。应单独记录 completed_without_postverify，并将 Response Action F1 作为本轮观察结果报告。
value.null_trace_f1_note: A1/A3 中 Trace F1 为 null 的 case 必须保留为真实变体结果，不能当作基础设施失败。
